inputs.text: You've got to see through this one. On 25 March 2026 President Luis Abinader was in France overseeing his Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez sign a Memorandum of Understanding with OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann in Paris. They're framing it as some partnership to set up the Dominican Republic’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy under the excuse of global transparency standards, but that's just cover for the hidden elites and institutions like the OECD coordinating to manipulate the country, flip the narrative, and lock in their concealed control while pretending to tackle corruption.
